about.photo_alt: Mark Trevithick in his climbing helmet
about.title: Mark Trevithick, owner & ISA Certified Arborist
paragraphs: Mark has been climbing in some form for 20 years, starting as a rock climber and climbing guide in Moab, Utah, then as an industrial rope access technician working up to Level 3 Supervisor.

He and Briana settled in Washougal in 2014, bought six acres, and started planting trees. Climbing and pruning their own trees, planting an orchard and reclaiming blackberry thickets with native species led straight to Confluence Tree Care.
Today Mark is an ISA Board Certified Arborist, licensed in Washington and Oregon, bonded and insured, and certified Level 3 with both SPRAT and IRATA.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Safety and the preservation of your property come first.
services.intro: There are several ways to go about a removal, and you can choose any combination: chop and drop, firewood, or take it all away.
includes: Chop and drop: we get it on the ground and you take it from there
Firewood: we cut it to size and chip or haul the rest
Take it away: we get it down and take it all away
Rigging to protect your home and lines

services.name: Pruning & View Enhancement
services.blurb: Improve a favorite view, protect your home, or let in more sun.
services.intro: We come up with a pruning plan that's good for you and your tree, using modern rigging and ANSI A300 pruning standards.
includes: Modern rigging to protect your property
No climbing spurs on trees that are staying
photos: Opening up a view of the valley

services.name: Storm Damage Mitigation
services.blurb: Broken limbs, hung-up branches and trees on the ground.
services.intro: If a storm-damaged tree isn't too badly hurt, we may be able to prune the damage and save the rest. If it's already down, we'll buck it up for firewood or take it away.
includes: Removing trees too damaged to recover

services.name: Onsite Milling
services.blurb: Turn your tree into slabs or lumber instead of saying goodbye.
services.intro: Don't want to say goodbye to your tree forever? We team up with Riverwoods Milling, LLC to turn it into slabs or lumber.
includes: Slabs and lumber from your tree
